messages:
Anya (PM): Quick sync — need to pick next two models for onboarding into the public catalog. Customer asks + infra costs pushing here. Shortpoints: impact, effort, and rollout risk.
Alex K: proposed set: Llama-4o-13B-8bit, Falcon-180B-ptq, and Red-70B-int8 (community fork).
Mira Patel: can we not pick 3 at once? let's score them against RICE and compatibility with dedicated/private.
Anya (PM): agreed. quick RICE sketch please. We should prioritize one high-impact/low-effort and one high-impact/high-effort for Q2 roadmap.
Juan R: note: Falcon-180B needs special kernel work on our runtime, effort high. Customers: two enterprise partners asked for broader context windows (>32k) which Falcon supports.
Samir J: Llama-4o-13B-8bit looks promising: low memory, good perf in hosted, small perf delta in dedicated. effort low-medium.
Mira Patel: Red-70B-int8 is risky — offline evals show slightly worse instruction following, but cost 40% lower. risk of quality regressions.
Anya (PM): here's a quick RICE table I sketched, very rough:
```
Model                 Reach   Impact   Confidence   Effort  RICE
Llama-4o-13B-8bit     40      4        0.8          3       42.6
Falcon-180B-ptq       25      5        0.6          8       11.25
Red-70B-int8          30      3        0.5          4       11.25
```
Anya (PM): RICE leans Llama-4o first. But we should check revenue-weighted reach (enterprise requests > product hooks).
prod-bot: Poll created — "Which model should be first for Q2 onboarding?" options: Llama-4o, Falcon-180B, Red-70B.
Alex K: I'm +1 for Llama-4o as primary. then Falcon-180B as stretch (but needs infra spike).
Juan R: operational constraints: Falcon might need a kernel vendor path for NVLink across pods; that adds timeline risk for private deployments.
Mira Patel: launch criteria proposal for each onboarding: 1) host perf: 95th p95 latency within 1.5x baseline for equivalent size, 2) quality: pass 90% of acceptance prompt set, 3) cost: per-token cost lower than current 13B baseline for similar quality, 4) rollout plan: staged canary + canary rollback triggers.
Samir J: can we add "compatibility with deduped KV cache format" to criteria? private installs might have older agents.
Anya (PM): yes, add compatibility check. also need to decide scope: do we include quantized variants in initial catalog entry or add later? My ask: include the quantized variant only if it meets the quality baseline; otherwise list it as "experimental" behind feature flag.
Alex K: engineering preference: ship Llama-4o baseline first and enable 8-bit variant behind flag with telemetry. That reduces rollback surface.
Juan R: customers who requested Falcon are ok waiting longer if we promise a dedicated pilot. maybe move Falcon to "enterprise pilot" track rather than public catalog this quarter.
Mira Patel: sounds good. final ask: product should document estimated unit economics per model (p95 latency, tokens/sec, $/1M tokens) before approval. I'll take that action.
Anya (PM): plan: 1) Q2 primary: Llama-4o-13B (8bit variant behind flag), 2) Q2 stretch/enterprise pilot: Falcon-180B-ptq (dedicated only), 3) Red-70B-int8: deprioritize for public catalog until evals improve.
Samir J: noted. I'll open infra tickets for benchmark rigs and a canary rollout playbook.
Alex K: I'll prep eval prompt sets and perf baselines.
Mira Patel: I'll update the roadmap doc and add revenue-weighted reach numbers.
Anya (PM): perfect. if no objections by EOD we'll freeze this for planning. :thumbsup:
